----------------------------------------------------------------------
Changes included in 2026-08-07.1
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Overview: 
- New beta-lactamase families  blaACES, blaBAS, and blaGUA.
- New blaEC alleles to cover blaEC that have distinct phenotypes when
  expressed.
- Curator review of start sites indicated a few incorrect start sites,
  blaCMY-20 was removed with no full-length alternative; it will be resurrected
